llm_response.reason: The website mimics Microsoft Windows security alerts and uses urgent, alarming messages to frighten users about non-existent threats, instructing them to call a fake technical support number. It deploys psychological scare tactics, fake system error codes, and pretends to block access to incite action. The site is hosted on an unconventional cloud storage domain, has no legitimate business information, and closely matches warning signs for Technical Support Scams, including spoofed Microsoft branding (characteristics 3, 4, 6, 10, 14, 16).
